featured_reviews.review_text: I went to this place reading all the Google reviews and ratings, being skeptical about how my experience will be with Navkar Mobile. I had a expensive phone so I wanted to make sure I don't give it in the wrong hands..He was quick to do the diagnosis of my phone and within 10 minutes he told me that it's not a display issue. I asked him if I can get it in two to three days, he told me we can give it to you as soon as the parts are arranged..I told him fine, in 1 hour I receive a call saying he has got the parts and my phone will be ready in 2 hours to my pleasent service.. .This is a gem of a place with a expert sitting there to solve mobile issues and with genuine costs which will be told to you upfront..I would recommend Navkar services for Mobile solutions to all my fellow #Thanekars. Thanks Bhavesh..
